profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at G&C Food Distributors Inc
profile.summary: Skilled .NET/C# and DevOps engineer with an aptitude for architecting effective solutions to technological challenges and a proven track record of developing successful business applications spanning over a decade of professional experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Maintain legacy ASP.NET applications, APIs, and SQL Server DBs. Modernizing .NET Framework/Core apps to .NET. 
-Create new .NET Blazor applications and APIs (Customer Onboarding portal, Market 2.0, Security Operations portal, Warehouse iOS/Android app etc.). 
-Create, modernize, and secure Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines across dev, test, and prod for dozens of custom applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Blazor · ASP.NET · C# · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
-Architected, implemented, and maintained the backend solutions for Crony Corp (Unity Client, API, Admin UI, Postgres DB). 
-Automated Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines across Dev/Test/Prod. 
-Provisioned and maintained all Azure resources (VNet, App Service, Database for PostgreSQL, Static Web App, Virtual Network Gateway, Seq centralized logging).
-Game client created in Unity, written in C#.
-Rest API written in .NET/C#. 
-Admin UI written in .NET Blazor. 
-DB Migrator written in .NET using Fluent Migrator library.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps Services · Microsoft Azure · Unity · Software Architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained the client data transfer APIs and applications which handle file transformations, (PGP encryption, compression, renaming, routing, etc), as well as inbound/outbound data transfers (FTPS, SFTP, LAN, HTTPS, S3, Blob, etc) between Thru's client's machines and the Thru MFT cloud, Version 2.0. 

Tech Stack: C#, .NET 6, Docker, Microsoft SQL Server, Mass Transit, Rabbit MQ, Redis, REST APIs
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · .NET Framework · Database Design · Agile Methodologies · Docker Products · API Development · JetBrains Rider · Encryption · C# · Managed File Transfer

positions.title: Unity Developer
positions.description:
Developed and co-designed Depixtion, a relaxing puzzle game in which the player creates beautiful works of art by solving logic puzzles. Made with Unity (C#).
-6/19, Launched on Steam (Windows, Mac, Linux)
-2/20, Launched on Nintendo Switch
-10/20, Launched Halloween DLC on all platforms
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Nintendo Switch · Agile Methodologies · Unity

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Client: Hasko Trading Inc. (a.k.a. Awkward Styles)

Design and develop a proprietary MRP solution for an up and coming garment printing company. The application receives orders from a customer-facing eCommerce storefront and creates "jobs" to track the status of each garment as it is picked from inventory, manufactured on the shop floor, and shipped. 

Tech Stack: ASP.NET MVC, C#, Microsoft SQL Server, REST APIs, Entity Framework, IIS, JavaScript, Bootstrap

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Client: Texas Military Department (Public Affairs)

Developed a cross-platform (iOS, Android, UWP in Xamarin) mobile app and admin CMS backend website (ASP.NET, MS SQL Server) to facilitate communication between members of the TMD, as well as from the TMD to the public at large. 

Tech Stack: ASP.NET MVC, Xamarin, C#, REST APIs, Microsoft SQL Server, Git, Entity Framework, JavaScript, Bootstrap

positions.title: Unity Developer
positions.description:
Clients: USACE - Sacremento Division and the Nevada Silver Jackets Team.

Developed and co-designed the "Flood Fighter: Nevada" project, a 3D flood management simulation video game. The goal of the project was to increase public awareness of flood management facts and procedures for community members living in and around the Nevada watersheds. FF:N simulates several heavy rainfall and snowmelt scenarios, as well as teaching concepts like ground saturation, delayed inflow, dam outflow, river stage and flow speed, debris blockage, levee erosion, levee inspection and emergency repair, and more.

Tech Stack: Unity3D, C#, MonoDevelop, Git.

positions.title: IT Generalist
positions.description:
Procurement and Logistics (July 2015 - Sept. 2015)
- Source and purchase requested IT hardware for various federal agencies (RFPs, FedBizOps)

Univar/Magnablend Database Integration (Sept. 2015 - Jan. 2016)
- Consolidate data collection and corrections between Univar and Magnablend personnel
- Validate data changes and redistribute updated tables daily
- Create automated macros for data population, cleaning and reformatting using VBA for Excel and Access

Data Analysis Consulting (Jan. 2016 - July 2016)
- Various data visualization and reporting services (Crystal Reports and Tableau)

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas
